content: dxcam 0.3.0 (PyPI, 2026-03; revived by ra1nty, 0.4.0 dev builds). DXGI Desktop Duplication default + optional WinRT backend; grab(region=(l,t,r,b), new_frame_only=False) returns ndarray; BGRA needs no cv2, BGR uses cv2 processor. Local bench on this PC: 1366x768 dxcam 7 ms vs mss 17 ms; 1920x1080 16 vs 33 ms.
